title: Pill button splits into an icon trio
summary: A single labelled pill button dims its label, then breaks into three round chips (payment, cart, item count) and later merges back. One flat light shot, no cuts, a seamless loop for a micro-interaction demo.
use_when: Showing a button that expands into quick actions or a status count
An e-commerce or checkout micro-interaction clip, silent and loopable
A short UI detail insert inside a longer product film
A landing-page hero loop for a component or design-system release

look.type_style: geometric sans, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking, label about 6 % H; thin outline icons; count digit in white on the accent chip

sfx.event: chips merge back into the pill and settle

structure.shot: one yellow pill button centred on flat light grey: outline cart icon left, two-word action label right
structure.motion: pill stretches about 8 % wider f5 (easings.outQuint ~4 fr); label opacity 1 -> ~0.3 over f5-f12 (easings.linear 8 fr); icon stays

structure.shot: pill splits: a black chip slides out left with a card icon, a violet chip right with a one-digit count; yellow body shrinks to a circle
structure.motion: split f12-f25: side chips emerge from behind the pill edges, yellow width ~47 % W -> circle (springs.ui 13 fr, overshoot not measurable at 30 fps strip, none visible); label gone by f17

structure.shot: three equal round chips in a row with small even gaps: card, cart, count
structure.motion: hold 88 fr; nothing moves after the gap settles at f25

structure.shot: side chips part slightly, then the yellow chip widens over them back into the labelled pill
structure.motion: anticipation f113-f118: side chips move out ~10 px@1322 (easings.outQuint 5 fr); merge f118-f121: yellow grows over both chips (easings.inExpo ~4 fr); empty pill f121; label fades in f122-f129 (easings.outQuint 7 fr) while the pill settles its width (springs.ui)

structure.shot: labelled pill button at rest, same as the opening frame
structure.motion: hold 96 fr; last frame equals frame 0, so the clip loops

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, accent for the main pill, fg for the label and the left chip, a second accent for the count chip
params.content.label: button label, 1-3 words
params.content.icon: icon on the main pill (cart, bag, plus)
params.content.left: icon on the left chip (card, wallet)
params.content.count: number or short string on the right chip
params.timing.splitAt: frame the label starts to dim (default 5 at 30 fps)
params.timing.restHold: frames the pill rests before the loop (default 96)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; pill width 47 % of the frame width at 4:3, capped to 60 % of the short side
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0 and t = 3.6: label dims f5-f12, split f12-f25, merge f113-f121, label back by f129. Pill ~47 % W x 17 % H of a 1322x992 frame; chips are circles of the pill height with gaps ~3 % W. No cursor is visible, so cursor-path was not used. Proposed term pill-split (not in vocabulary). Camera reads static in every cell; motion.json reports ~-1.9 %/s zoom with zero frame difference, treated as estimator noise. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
